_note: Eight recruitable companions, one per class. Any of them can be recruited whatever the player's class. Recruit dialogues set <id>_met / <id>_recruited flags; map placements hide on <id>_recruited. preferredTalents is the auto-allocation order (one entry per point, each legal once the earlier ones are spent; empty = the class defaultBuild): Kael tanks (Protection, two-hander friendly), Seren heals (Holy, then Discipline), Aldric fights sword-and-board Retribution.

companions.name: Kael
companions.title: The Red Wanderer
companions.bio: Ten years ago Kael walked the summoner Isolde up the pilgrim stair as her guardian, and walked back down alone. He has lived at the Sleepy Lantern ever since — one cup of tea a day, watching the road to Whisperwood — keeping the promise he made at the top of the mountain: to watch over Isolde's daughter until she no longer needs watching.
companions.personality: Stoic, terse and dry as old bread, with a buried warmth that surfaces in deeds rather than words. Respects resolve; has no patience for dithering or cruelty.
companions.inspiration: Auron-like veteran guardian (FFX): heavy red greatcoat worn off one shoulder over mail, a pale scar closing one eye, grey-streaked hair, an enormous notched greatsword carried on the shoulder and a battered tea flask at the hip. Original character.

companions.name: Lys
companions.title: The Belted Sorceress
companions.bio: Lys grew up in Lanternvale, left for the Arcanum of Velmora at fourteen and came back a sorceress with a reputation and a notebook. Officially she is studying the Hollow. Unofficially, she has never stopped worrying about the summoner girl she used to walk to the shrine every festival.
companions.personality: Aloof, sardonic and precise; shows affection through criticism. Secretly sentimental — she keeps a book of pressed marigolds and will deny it to the grave.
companions.inspiration: Lulu-like black mage (FFX): a long dark dress made of crossing belts, fur-trimmed collar, dark braided hair pinned with long needles, and a staff topped with a storm-filled orb. Instead of a doll she carries a pressed-flower book she pretends is research. Original character.

companions.name: Seren
companions.title: Summoner on Pilgrimage
companions.bio: Seren is a summoner of the valley, walking the old pilgrimage to rekindle each shrine's lantern before she climbs to the Heart. Her mother, Isolde, made the same pilgrimage ten years ago and gave the Heart Lantern everything she had. Seren means to do the same if she must — and is quietly, desperately hoping she won't have to.
companions.personality: Gentle, earnest and braver than she feels; polite to a fault, stubborn as a mountain once decided. Laughs when she's nervous.
companions.inspiration: Yuna-like summoner-pilgrim (FFX): pale blue kimono top over a long flowing hakama skirt, a ringed staff that chimes with each step, dark hair with a single white streak and a beaded hair ornament. Original character.

companions.name: Rook
companions.title: Islander Ringball Captain
companions.bio: Rook captained the Saltreach Gulls to three ringball championships, lost a front tooth in the last final, and sailed off in search of the best fishing in the world. He found it in Whisperwood's river — just in time for the Hollow to turn it grey. He travels with Tide, a one-white-eared wolf he raised from a pup.
companions.personality: Big-hearted, loud, superstitious and loyal to the bone; treats every problem like a team sport. Goes quietly furious when animals suffer.
companions.inspiration: Wakka-like islander athlete (FFX): sun-browned and broad-shouldered, beaded hair under a bandana, leather and fur with a sporty number-seven vest, a driftwood recurve bow and a ringball on his hip. Original character. Suggested hunter pet: a grey wolf named Tide (art key pet_wolf).

companions.name: Pip
companions.title: Cogwright Scavenger
companions.bio: Pip left the Cogwright caravans — wandering tinkers who rescue junk and turn it into wonders — after accidentally inventing a self-propelled teapot. She drifts from village to village fixing things that weren't broken yet. She is terrified of ghosts, which is unfortunate, given the Hollow.
companions.personality: Cheerful, fast-talking, curious and impulsive; generous with everything except shiny things. Hides fear behind jokes.
companions.inspiration: Rikku-like goggled scavenger (FFX): oversized three-lens goggles, a bright scarf, short shorts and mismatched sleeves, a belt of pouches and twin cog-bladed daggers. Original character.

companions.name: Torvan
companions.title: Hornkin Oathkeeper
companions.bio: For a thousand years the Hornkin of the high snows guarded the Warden's herd. Torvan was on watch the night the grey took the Warden, and did not understand what he heard. He came down the mountain alone to set it right, and has stood at the foot of the shrine stair ever since, unwilling to fail the Great One twice.
companions.personality: Proud, solemn and sparing with words; formal in speech, fierce in battle and deeply tender with small creatures. Measures people by deeds, not promises.
companions.inspiration: Kimahri-like horned beast-folk (FFX): towering, silver-grey fur, great curled ram horns hung with braided cords and charms, tribal markings and a leaf-bladed spear-staff. Speaks in plain first person. Original character.
likes: Respect for spirits and the mountain

companions.name: Aldric
companions.title: Knight-Errant of Sunmere
companions.bio: The youngest of six sons of the House of Sunmere, Aldric ran away to become a legend after reading a very cheap chapbook about a knight called Sir Gallant. He has not slain a dragon yet. He has slain several dandelions, one scarecrow (accidentally) and his own dignity (regularly). He is entirely sincere.
companions.personality: Sunny, brash, impulsive and relentlessly optimistic; talks too much, laughs too loud and is braver than is strictly sensible. Underneath, desperate to prove he's more than the spare son.
companions.inspiration: Tidus-like sunny young hero (FFX): tousled blond hair, an asymmetric bright gold tabard with one bare arm, a sun-painted kite shield and a polished warhammer, and a grin that never quite switches off. Original character.

companions.name: Morwen
companions.title: Scholar of Demons
companions.bio: Morwen Vale-Ashcombe catalogues demons the way others catalogue butterflies: with great care, a pin, and a slightly alarming fondness. She came to Lanternvale certain the Hollow was a demonic incursion and has been politely disappointed ever since. Her imp, whom she calls 'Dear', carries her inkpot.
companions.personality: Elegant, courteous, morbidly curious and quietly unsettling; never raises her voice and never loses her smile. Values knowledge and boldness above comfort.
companions.inspiration: Original gothic-scholar warlock in FFX-style costume: a high-collared, violet-lined long coat with layered belts, violet runes stitched along the hems, silver rings, a leather grimoire and a tiny imp on her shoulder.
